The '''ND9 [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]]''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and deployed in the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE/ad Avenger]] and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], two of only a few [[TIE series/Legends|TIE-series]] craft to employ a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].
